faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Delhi Project Technical Support I recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Project Technical Support I position at AIIMS Delhi is 31 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates need to have a DMLT with 2 years of relevant experience or a BSc in Medical Laboratory Technology (MLT) with 1 year of relevant experience.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Technical Support I position?
faq.answer: The salary for this position will be as per ICMR norms, providing a competitive remuneration package.

faq.question: Q5. How will candidates be selected for the Project Technical Support I role?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting of eligible candidates followed by an interview to assess their suitability for the role.

faq.question: Q6. What is the type of job being offered?
faq.answer: The position of Project Technical Support I is a contractual job opportunity at AIIMS Delhi.

faq.question: Q7. Where is the AIIMS Delhi located?
faq.answer: AIIMS Delhi is located in New Delhi, Delhi.

faq.question: Q8. Are there any age limit relaxations mentioned?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify any age limits or relaxations for this particular post.

faq.question: Q9. What documents are required to be submitted with the application?
faq.answer: Candidates need to attach self-attested copies of educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.

faq.question: Q10. How should the application be submitted?
faq.answer: Applications should be submitted via email, with the post applied for clearly mentioned in the subject line.
